name: Pendulum Squat
instructions: Step onto the platform, set your shoulders under the pads and place your feet low and close on the plate.
Release the safety and brace your core with your back flat against the pad.
Bend your knees and let the arm swing you down until your thighs pass parallel.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up without locking out hard.

name: Belt Squat
instructions: Attach the belt around your hips and stand on the platforms with the weight hanging below you.
Stand tall, brace your core and lift the weight off the support.
Sit down and back between your feet until your thighs are at least parallel.
Push the floor away to return to standing while keeping your torso upright.

name: V-Squat Machine
instructions: Position your shoulders under the pads and your feet shoulder-width on the angled platform.
Unlock the safeties and keep your back pressed against the backrest.
Lower under control until your knees reach about 90 degrees or slightly deeper.
Press up through your midfoot and stop just short of locking your knees.

name: Hip Thrust Machine
instructions: Sit with your upper back against the pad and the belt or lever across your hips.
Place your feet flat about hip-width apart and tuck your chin slightly.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes for a moment at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Glute Kickback Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad so your hips line up with the pivot, then place one foot on the plate.
Hold the handles and keep your torso braced against the pad.
Press the plate back and up by extending your hip without arching your lower back.
Pause and squeeze your glute, then return slowly and finish all reps before switching legs.

name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine
instructions: Select the assistance weight, then kneel or stand on the platform and grip the handles.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back to start the movement.
Drive your elbows toward your ribs until your chin clears the bar.
Lower under control until your arms are fully extended.

name: Lateral Raise Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivot and place your arms against the pads.
Sit tall with your chest up and grip the handles lightly.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach about shoulder height.
Lower slowly and keep tension on the side delts without letting the weight stack rest.

name: Chest-Supported Row Machine
instructions: Set the chest pad so your arms can fully extend and sit with your chest firmly against it.
Grab the handles with a neutral or overhand grip.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, then stretch forward under control for the next rep.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
instructions: Lie chest-down on the pad and grip the T-bar handles with your arms extended.
Keep your neck neutral and your feet planted or hooked.
Row the handles toward your lower ribs while driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your upper back at the top and lower to a full stretch.

name: Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Row
instructions: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the handles.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back to start.
Row the handles toward your hips, driving your elbows past your torso.
Return slowly until your lats are fully stretched.

name: Single-Arm Cable Row
instructions: Sit at a low cable station with one handle in hand and your feet braced.
Sit tall with your free hand on your thigh and your shoulder blade relaxed forward.
Pull the handle to your hip while keeping your elbow close to your side.
Return slowly until your arm is straight, then finish the set and switch sides.

name: Wide-Grip Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit at a cable row with a wide bar and your feet braced.
Keep your chest tall and your arms straight.
Pull the bar to your lower chest with your elbows flared out.
Return slowly until your shoulder blades protract.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand side-on to a low pulley and grab the handle with the far hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow and a tall chest.
Raise your arm out to the side until it is about shoulder height.
Lower slowly so the cable keeps tension on the shoulder throughout.

name: Cable Y-Raise
instructions: Set two low pulleys and grab the opposite handles so the cables cross in front of you.
Stand tall with soft knees and your ribs down.
Lift both arms up and out into a Y shape with thumbs pointing up.
Lower slowly under control without shrugging your shoulders.

name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys low, grab the handles and step forward into a staggered stance.
Lean slightly forward with a soft bend in your elbows.
Sweep your hands up and together to about chin height, squeezing the upper chest.
Open your arms slowly back to a comfortable stretch.

name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys high, grab the handles and step forward into a staggered stance.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows and your chest proud.
Sweep your hands down and together toward your lower abdomen.
Return in a slow arc until you feel a stretch across your chest.

name: Seated Cable Fly
instructions: Sit on a bench between two cable stations and hold the handles at chest height.
Keep a small bend in your elbows and your back against the pad.
Bring your hands together in a hugging arc in front of your chest.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
instructions: Set a low pulley, face away from it and hold the handle behind your body with one hand.
Step forward so the cable pulls your arm slightly behind your torso.
Curl the handle up while keeping your upper arm back and your elbow still.
Lower slowly to a full stretch before the next rep.

name: Cable Triceps Kickback
instructions: Set a low pulley with a single handle and hinge forward with a flat back.
Pin your upper arm against your side with your elbow bent.
Extend your elbow until your arm is straight behind you.
Return slowly without swinging your upper arm.

name: Cable Lat Prayer
instructions: Kneel facing a high cable with a rope in your hands and arms extended in front of you.
Hinge slightly and brace your core.
Pull the rope down to your forehead with straight arms.
Return slowly to full stretch.

name: Standing Single-Arm Cable Press
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and stand facing away with a staggered stance.
Hold the handle at your chest and brace your core.
Press the handle forward until your arm is straight.
Return slowly without twisting your torso.

name: Landmine Press
instructions: Wedge one end of a barbell into a landmine or corner and hold the other end at your shoulder.
Stand tall with a staggered stance and braced core.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is fully extended.
Lower back to your shoulder with control.

name: Landmine Row
instructions: Straddle the barbell end of a landmine and hinge at your hips with a flat back.
Grip the bar or a handle attachment under the plates.
Row the bar to your lower chest by driving your elbows back.
Lower under control until your arms are straight.

name: Landmine Squat
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine barbell against your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
Squat down while the bar counterbalances you and keeps your chest tall.
Stand up by driving through your whole foot.

name: Meadows Row
instructions: Set a landmine barbell and stand perpendicular to it with a staggered stance.
Hinge at the hips and grip the thick end of the bar with the near hand.
Row your elbow up and back toward your hip.
Lower slowly to a full stretch and keep your hips still.

name: Seal Row
instructions: Lie face-down on a raised bench with a barbell hanging below you.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Pull the bar up to the underside of the bench by driving your elbows back.
Lower under control to full arm extension.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your ankles anchored under a pole or held by a partner.
Keep your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your torso toward the floor as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands, then push lightly off the floor to return.

name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your top leg resting on a bench and your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold the position while keeping your hips stacked and the bottom leg off the floor.
Lower with control and repeat on the other side.

name: Rotary Torso Machine
instructions: Sit in the machine, secure your legs and place your arms on the pads.
Keep your hips facing forward and your back tall.
Rotate your torso to one side through a comfortable range.
Return slowly and complete all reps before switching sides.

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the Smith bar over your hips with a pad.
Plant your feet flat and hip-width apart.
Unrack the bar and drive your hips up until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower with control.

name: SkiErg
instructions: Stand facing the machine with feet hip-width apart and the handles in each hand.
Reach up and pull the handles down in a smooth arc while hinging at the hips.
Let your arms rise as your body returns to standing.
Keep a steady rhythm and breathe consistently.

name: Incline Treadmill Walk
instructions: Set the treadmill to a moderate incline and a comfortable walking speed.
Walk tall without holding the rails if you can.
Keep your steps relaxed and your breathing steady.
Lower the incline and slow down for the last minute.

name: Rowing Machine Intervals
instructions: Strap in your feet and sit tall with your shins vertical at the catch.
Drive with your legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your ribs.
Reverse the order on the way back: arms, torso, then knees.
Alternate hard efforts with easy rowing recoveries.

name: Stair Climber Intervals
instructions: Step onto the machine and stand tall with light hand support.
Climb at a steady pace using your whole foot on each step.
Alternate a fast block with a slower recovery block.
Finish with an easy minute to bring your heart rate down.

name: Elliptical Intervals
instructions: Step on the elliptical and hold the handles with a relaxed grip.
Move in a smooth stride with an upright posture.
Raise resistance or speed for hard intervals, then lower it to recover.
Finish with a slow easy cooldown.

name: Burpee
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, then squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor, push up and jump your feet back to your hands.
Explode upward into a jump with your hands overhead.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at your hips, grab the handle and hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing the bell to chest height with straight arms.
Let the bell fall back and hinge again, keeping your back flat.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand a stride length in front of a bench and rest the top of your rear foot on it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor until your front thigh is parallel.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up, then switch legs after the set.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back with soft knees and a flat back.
Slide the dumbbells down your legs until you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell across your hips.
Plant your feet flat and hip-width apart.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.

name: Z Press
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight in front of you and a barbell at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are locked out.
Lower back to your shoulders with control.

name: Trap Bar Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand inside a trap bar and take the handles with soft knees.
Hinge at your hips and push them back while keeping your spine flat.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

name: Pistol Squat to Box
instructions: Stand on a box on one leg with the other leg out in front.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Squat down on one leg until you lightly touch the box.
Stand back up without letting your knee cave in.

name: Dragon Flag
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head, lifting your body so only your upper back touches.
Keep your body rigid from shoulders to toes.
Lower your body slowly toward the bench without bending at the hips.
Lift back up using your abs and repeat.

name: Reverse Nordic Curl
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your body upright and your arms by your sides or crossed.
Keep your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Lean back as far as you can control.
Use your quads to pull yourself upright again.

name: Tibialis Raise
instructions: Lean your back against a wall with your feet a step forward.
Keep your legs straight and your heels on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins as high as you can.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs a few inches off the ground.
Keep your arms by your ears or at your sides.
Breathe steadily while holding the position.

name: L-Sit Hold
instructions: Place your hands on parallel bars or the floor beside your hips.
Press down to lift your body off the ground.
Raise your straight legs in front of you until they are parallel to the floor.
Hold while keeping your shoulders pushed down.

name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms straight and your shoulders active.
Keep your legs still and your breathing steady.
Hold for the target time, then step down.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and walk your feet forward.
Slide down until your knees are at about 90 degrees.
Keep your back flat and your weight over your heels.
Hold the position for the target time.

name: Glute Bridge March
instructions: Lie on your back in a glute bridge position with your hips high.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Lift one foot a few inches, then place it back and switch.
Repeat without letting your hips drop.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend one arm and the opposite leg until they are in line with your torso.
Hold briefly without rotating your hips.
Return and switch sides.
